title: Concept: pubspec.lock pins a non-hosted source
description: pubspec.lock declares a locked package whose source is git or a local path, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The locked version is not a hosted artifact, so nothing on the package server can attest or revoke it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.lock (pub).
risk: The locked version is not a hosted artifact, so nothing on the package server can attest or revoke it.
